card.name: Names and word endings in news text
card.fires_on: Fires on proper names such as Scalia, Seinfeld, Schumann, Framingham and Bucknell, often on the later part of the name. Also fires on 'unmanned' before spacecraft or rocket names and on 'upholstered'.

modes.label: Surnames and place names
modes.description: The word is a surname or the end of a split proper name, often a justice, composer or school.
